## Component Name

Name and proposed directive syntax (e.g. `:::my-component{attr="value"}`).

## Purpose

What does this component do? What type of exercise or visualization does it provide?

## Behavior

- How does the user interact with it?
- What feedback is shown?
- Should it track progress?

## Example Usage

```markdown
:::my-component{answer="42"}
Question or content here.
:::
```

## Design Reference

Any mockups, screenshots, or references to similar implementations.
